bio.text: Maxine Dexter was elected to the U.S. House in 2024 and represents Oregon's 3rd Congressional District.

A physician, she practiced for over 15 years as a lung and critical care doctor at Kaiser Permanente, and in 2020 was appointed to the Oregon House of Representatives, where she chaired the Housing and Homelessness Committee.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Washington and attended its school of medicine.
